'''Françoise Winnik''' (2 March 1952 – 13 February 2021) was a French-born Canadian chemical researcher and professor. She was awarded the {{ill|Prix Acfas Urgel-Archambault|fr}} in 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://archive.wikiwix.com/cache/index2.php?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ledevoir.com%2Fsociete%2Fscience-et-technologie%2F453169%2Fprix-urgel-archambault-sciences-physiques-mathematiques-informatique-et-genie-hors-des-trajectoires-normales|title=Wikiwix's cache|website=archive.wikiwix.com}}</ref>

Winnink was born and raised in France, where she earned her undergraduate degree in chemical engineering at the National School of Chemistry in Mulhouse, in 1973. She finished her master's degree and PhD in [[Toronto]], Canada in 1974 and 1979 respectively. She later became associate professor at the [[University of Montreal]]. the chemistry and physics departments at McMaster University in Canada.{{clarify|date=March 2021}} In 2018, she moved to Finland and worked at the [[University of Helsinki]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nims.go.jp/mana/member/principal_investigator/francoise_m_winnik.html|title=Francoise M. Winnik &#124; People &#124; MANA}}</ref><ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=http://axial.acs.org/2021/03/03/remembering-francoise-winnik/|title=Remembering Former Langmuir Editor-in-Chief Françoise Winnik|date=March 3, 2021}}</ref><ref name="auto2">{{Cite web|url=http://sociedadpolimerica.org.mx/node/183|title=Obituary Prof. Françoise Winnik &#124; Sociedad Polimérica de México|website=sociedadpolimerica.org.mx}}</ref><ref name="auto">{{Cite web|url=https://nouvelles.umontreal.ca/article/2021/03/01/in-memoriam-francoise-winnik/|title=article|date=November 18, 2020|website=nouvelles.umontreal.ca|access-date=March 11, 2021|archive-date=April 16, 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210416131659/https://nouvelles.umontreal.ca/article/2021/03/01/in-memoriam-francoise-winnik/|url-status=dead}}</ref> She was elected Foreign Member of [[Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters|The Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters]] in 2013.<ref>{{Cite book|title=SPHINX Societas Scientiarum Fennica Yearbook 2019-2020|publisher=Finnis Society of Sciences and Letters|year=2020}}</ref>

Winnik died in [[Helsinki]] on 13 February 2021.<ref name="auto1"/><ref name="auto2"/><ref name="auto"/>

== Publications ==
* 2001. S. Mansouri, Y. Mehri, F. M. Winnik, M. Tabrizian. « Investigation of the layer-by-layer assembly onto fully functional human red blood cells in suspension for attenuated immune response », dans Biomacromolecules, 2001, 12, pp.&nbsp;585–592.
* 2010. V. A. Kryuchkov. J. C. Daigle, K. M. Skupov, J. Claverie, F. M. Winnik. « Amphiphilic polyethylenes leading to surfactant-free thermoresponsive nanoparticles », dans Journal of American Chemistry Society, 2010, 133(44), pp.&nbsp;15573–15579.
